title: feat(fields): offer the mobile shell's code scanner on text and lookup fields
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"zhuangjianguo"} -->
_Requested by **Steedos** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb?thread=cmsg_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9UbbQnx983aXpxUvWnKCfqDKdq)_

Fixes #29378

Clause-②: yes
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**：在 ObjectStack 移动壳内（桥接 `has('scan')` 为真时），可编辑的单行文本字段与查找（lookup）字段旁出现一个「扫码」图标按钮；文本字段把解码结果经 `onChange` 写入，查找字段用解码结果打开搜索。普通浏览器、旧版壳、只读或禁用字段不显示按钮。
- **为什么改**：移动壳已上线 `scan()`（objectstack-ai/mobile#170），Console 端没有调用方，就是「声明了却没人用」的能力；现场用户用手机录入资产标签、条码、单据号时需要它。
- **风险与回滚**：新增的公开面全部是加法：`@object-ui/mobile` 的 `NativeHostMethod` 加 `'scan'`、`ObjectStackNative` 加可选 `scan?(opts)`、新导出 `NativeScanOptions` 与 `nativeScan(opts?)`；`@object-ui/fields` 的 `PeoplePicker` 加可选 prop `initialSearch`；`@object-ui/i18n` 十个语言包各加 `fields.scan.button`、`fields.scan.failed` 两个键；`@object-ui/fields` 新增依赖 `@object-ui/mobile`（mobile 只依赖 types，无环）。浏览器里按钮不渲染、DOM 不变。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- **先看**：`ui/packages/fields/src/widgets/ScanFieldButton.tsx`（显示门 `useFieldScanOffered` 与失败 toast）；`ui/packages/fields/src/widgets/LookupField.tsx`（`handleScanned` 与 `lookupScan` 的门控）；`ui/packages/mobile/src/nativeHost.ts`（`nativeScan`）。
- **两分钟验证**：`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/fields/src/widgets/ScanFieldButton.shellScan.test.tsx` 应 13/13 通过；截图见下方 Verification（390 px，桩桥接）。
- **需要你做的**：无，席位落地。

## What changes

- **`@object-ui/mobile`** types the bridge's scan method, mirroring mobile `docs/HYBRID-SHELL.md` "Scanning codes": `'scan'` joins `NativeHostMethod`; `ObjectStackNative` gains an OPTIONAL `scan?(opts)` (a shell older than the scanner does not carry it, and a required member would break typed stubs); `NativeScanOptions` (`formats?: string[]`) is exported; `nativeScan(opts?)` goes through `callNative` and resolves `unavailable`, `ok` with the decoded text or `null` (scanner closed), or `failed` with the shell's code and message. The method is called on the bridge, so the bridge stays its `this`.
- **`@object-ui/fields`** gains a dependency on `@object-ui/mobile` (mobile depends only on `@object-ui/types`; plugin-grid, list, calendar and timeline already take this edge). An internal `ScanFieldButton` plus `useFieldScanOffered()` (not exported from the package entry) reads `useNativeHost()`, so a bridge the shell injects late re-renders the field with the button.
  - `TextField`: the single-line input only (not password, not the multi-row textarea, not disabled or read-only). The decoded text REPLACES the value through `onChange`, the same path a keystroke takes, so the host's validation judges it; it is not cut to `maxLength`, which would lose scanned data silently.
  - `LookupField`: the classic popover and the static-option list open with the code in their search box; the search-first variant (`picker: 'search'`) opens `PeoplePicker` seeded through the new optional `initialSearch` prop, cleared when it closes. Gated like the trigger: no button when disabled, when `dependsOn` is unmet, in compact (inline cell) mode, or on a classic lookup whose target offers no search.
  - Outcomes: `ok` with text runs the handler; `ok` with `null` or `unavailable` does nothing; `failed` raises `toast.error` from `@object-ui/components` (the sonner instance the Console mounts) with the new key as title and the shell's message as description.
- **`@object-ui/i18n`**: `fields.scan.button` ("Scan code") and `fields.scan.failed` ("Could not scan") in all ten locales, plus `FIELD_DEFAULTS` for a provider-less render.
- No metadata key: the affordance follows the bridge capability, so `Metadata-protocol: none`.

## Tests

- New `ScanFieldButton.shellScan.test.tsx` (13 cases) with a stub `window.ObjectStackNative`: plain browser and `has('scan')` false render no button (text and lookup); read-only, disabled and password render none; the decoded value lands through `onChange`; `null` changes nothing and raises no toast; `failed` raises the toast with the shell message; a lookup's decoded value opens the dropdown with it in the search box and drives the `$search` query; `null` leaves a lookup closed; the search-first variant opens `PeoplePicker` seeded.
- `nativeHost.test.tsx` extended: `scan` joins the unavailable / has-says-no / method-missing tables; `ok` with text (formats forwarded, bridge kept as `this`), `ok` with `null`, and `failed` with the shell message.
- **Ablation** (`scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, source-resolved through the vitest alias): replacing `return host.has('scan') === true;` with `return (host.has('scan') || true) === true;` in `ScanFieldButton.tsx` reds exactly the two older-shell pins (2 failed, 11 passed); restored, blob equal to HEAD and `git diff HEAD` empty.

## Acceptance notes

- Compact (inline grid cell) lookups get no scan button, matching the single-select clear control, which compact mode also omits.
- The multi-select search-first lookup renders its row with `display: contents`, so the scan button sits on its own line under the trigger there.
- `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` is NOT MEASURED locally (exit 3, needs a full `pnpm build`); it scans the root `packages/` tree only, so no ui package is in its population. CI runs it.

## Verification

Local runs on head `bf41e3ae` (suites, gates), then main merged at `c6569d87` (main touched none of `ui/packages/fields`, `mobile`, `i18n` or the lockfile; the two scan test files re-ran green there: 2 files, 59 tests).

<details><summary>Suites and type-check</summary>

- `turbo run type-check` for `@object-ui/fields`, `@object-ui/mobile`, `@object-ui/i18n`: 50 tasks successful (each package's `tsc --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json` echoed).
- `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/mobile/ packages/i18n/`: Test Files 104 passed, Tests 1567 passed, 13 skipped.
- `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/fields/`: Test Files 294 passed, 1 skipped; Tests 4426 passed, 7 skipped.
- `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run scripts/`: Test Files 169 passed, 2 skipped; Tests 4921 passed.

</details>

<details><summary>Derived gates</summary>

`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` derived 54 families; 53 exit 0, `pnpm check:dual-build-cjs-loads` exit 3 (prerequisite). `--ran` reconciliation: 54 accounted for, 53 run, 1 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN. `node scripts/check-sdui-manifest.mjs` exit 0. `pnpm --dir ui run check:new-line-citations`: 0 new citations.

</details>

<details><summary>Phone-width screenshots (390 px, stub bridge)</summary>

A temporary Console Vite entry rendered the real `TextField` and `LookupField` with an in-memory data source, then was deleted. Playwright readings: plain browser, 0 scan buttons; shell stub, 2 buttons; after scanning, the text input holds `ASSET-0042` and the lookup dropdown opens with search `ASSET-0042` listing only "ASSET-0042 Forklift"; a refused camera shows the toast "Could not scan / Camera permission denied". Files in the project thread: `phone-plain-browser.png`, `phone-shell-buttons.png`, `phone-shell-after-scan.png`, `phone-shell-scan-failed.png`.

</details>
